source.ownershipBasis: The maintainer confirmed ownership of the original repository.

license.scope: Project code and documentation the maintainer has the right to license; third-party materials retain their own terms.

fingerprint.coverage: All Git-tracked files at this release, except FINGERPRINT.sha256 itself. Local configuration, credentials, runtime data and ignored files are excluded.
fingerprint.generation: Stage the release files, run node scripts/fingerprint.mjs --write, then stage FINGERPRINT.sha256.
fingerprint.limitations: File integrity checks only; not a cryptographic signature, proof of ownership or copy protection. Regenerate after changing tracked files.

publication.scope: Runnable source, required application media, tests, setup and licensing documents. Original high-resolution generation assets and research archives remain in the local development repository; historical commits are not included in this public snapshot.
